judgement.reason: SFTPGo can run with PostgreSQL/MySQL and S3 storage backends via configuration, so a contained change is plausible.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (users_base_dir = /srv/sftpgo/data (Dockerfile)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile sets users_base_dir to /srv/sftpgo/data for user files on the local filesystem, and no shown line selects S3 or another supported store in its place, so the finding holds.
